Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Vairocana — Innate Technique (11th level)

At 11th level, you have learned to balance the chaos and harmony. When you use Chaos, you can choose either Order or Equilibrium:

Order. You control a random element of the rolled Chaos effect. This can include where an area of effect appears, which creature is affected, or the place a creature teleports to.

Equilibrium. This causes a number of creatures up to your Cursed Energy modifier to be immune to the Chaos effect. They cannot take damage or be selected by the Chaos. After using this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
